messages.content: You are a careful front-end developer. Return only the requested JSON schema. The user-facing text must be natural Georgian. Treat personal-data placeholders literally.

Create an independent, concise HTML5 + CSS proposal for a Georgian personal contact page. This is an exam about using AI tools. Compare list/card/table briefly in layoutRecommendation, then prefer a semantic contact card. Use NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, SOCIAL_URL placeholders, never invent personal contact values. Required visible Georgian labels: დამიკავშირდი, ელფოსტა, ტელეფონი, სოციალური ბმულები; brief human Georgian copy. Provide a complete HTML document in html and separate concise CSS in css. HTML links styles.css and has no inline scripts or event handlers. Design: warm paper #f7f4ee, ink #182d45, ochre #c8a567, white contact card, clean readable font, clear hierarchy, roomy padding. Responsive grid collapse at 700px, overflow-wrap for long email, focus-visible outlines, accessible link text, 44px minimum tap targets. Add exactly three ORIGINAL SVG icons named email.svg, phone.svg, arrow.svg: 24x24 viewBox, no scripts/events/external references, stroke #182d45, stroke-width 1.7, unfilled round caps. Each icon should communicate its function using simple paths. Provide 5 concise Georgian labels keyed heading, email, phone, social, copy. Provide 4 concrete code style/readability improvements in Georgian. Keep HTML and CSS compact, total response ideally under 2400 tokens. Do not use a CDN, web font, framework, testimonials, fake availability, contact form, prices or email success claims.
